service.description: Keyword search over the product tier and, when a tenant is named, that tenant's entries, merged by score.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: The one tenant whose entries join the search; product only when omitted.

parameter.name: words
parameter.description: Search words; codes such as R2 match whole.

parameter.name: system
parameter.description: Only entries about this system, e.g. oms.

parameter.name: kind
parameter.description: Only entries of this kind.

parameter.name: limit
parameter.description: Hits to answer; 5 by default, 20 at most.

parameter.name: hits
parameter.description: [{key, tier (product | tenant), title, snippet, source, reviewBy, score}] best first.

parameter.name: productTier
parameter.description: loaded, or absent when no product entry is loaded on this instance.

parameter.name: tenantTier
parameter.description: loaded, none (no tenant named) or deactivated (no tenant hits).

service.description: One whole entry by key: the product tier first, then the named tenant's active entry.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: The one tenant whose entries are looked in; product only when omitted.

parameter.name: key
parameter.description: The entry's key (its id: header).

parameter.name: entry
parameter.description: {key, tier, systems, kind, tags, source, owner, reviewBy, supersedes, title, body}, or null when neither tier holds the key.

service.description: Adds or replaces one tenant entry (by tenant and key) from its markdown file text. Refused, writing nothing, off a local instance, or when the text names another tenant or holds customer personal data.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: The tenant the entry belongs to.

parameter.name: markdown
parameter.description: The entry file: header, # title, body; tier: tenant.

parameter.name: entry
parameter.description: The stored entry, as get#KnowledgeEntry answers it.

parameter.name: created
parameter.description: True when the key was new for the tenant.

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.KnowledgeAdminServices.store#KnowledgeEntry', targetType: 'KnowledgeEntry', targetId: tenantUserGroupId + ':' + entry.key, detailText: (created ? 'Added' : 'Replaced') + ' knowledge entry ' + entry.key + '.', auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service.description: Retires one tenant entry: kept for history, never searched or answered again. Local instances only.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: The tenant the entry belongs to.

parameter.name: key
parameter.description: The entry's key.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when retired.

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.KnowledgeAdminServices.retire#KnowledgeEntry', targetType: 'KnowledgeEntry', targetId: tenantUserGroupId + ':' + key, detailText: 'Retired knowledge entry ' + key + '.', auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service.description: Entries due for a re-read (reviewBy within withinDays, expired ones included): product, plus the named tenant's.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: The one tenant whose entries are included; product only when omitted.

parameter.name: withinDays
parameter.description: Days ahead of today to include.

parameter.name: entries
parameter.description: [{key, tier, title, source, owner, reviewBy}] soonest first.

service.description: Every tenant's identifiers the leak check matches (tenant ids, labels, connection hosts, NetSuite accounts), for staff checking a product entry before commit. Names tenants: never ship the list.

parameter.name: identifiers
parameter.description: [{value, kind (tenantId | label | host | account), caseSensitive, tenantId}].
